exercises.name: Push-up
steps: Place your hands slightly wider than your shoulders and extend your legs behind you.
Brace your trunk and lower your body together by bending the elbows. Keep them angled back rather than flared sideways.
Use a comfortable depth, then press back up without letting your hips sag.
exercises.cue: Keep the head, trunk and legs aligned. Breathe in as you lower and out as you press.
exercises.mistake: Sagging hips, a flared elbow position or jerky repetitions. Reduce the difficulty if you cannot control your alignment.

exercises.name: Bodyweight squat
steps: Stand with feet a little wider than your shoulders.
Bend at the hips and knees into a comfortable depth. Keep knees following the direction of your feet.
Stand back up with control.
exercises.cue: Keep the spine neutral. Use your arms for balance.
exercises.mistake: Knees collapsing inward or the back rounding. End the set when alignment becomes difficult.

exercises.name: Dumbbell curl
steps: Hold a dumbbell with the palm facing forward.
Bend the elbow to lift the weight while the upper arm stays beside your body.
Lower slowly; repeat on the other side.
exercises.cue: Keep the wrist straight and the elbow close to your side.
exercises.mistake: Swinging the elbow or weight instead of controlling the movement.

exercises.name: Barbell curl
steps: Hold the bar with palms forward, hands about shoulder width.
Brace your abdomen and bend the elbows to lift.
Lower the bar slowly.
exercises.cue: Keep wrists neutral and upper arms near the torso.
exercises.mistake: Leaning back or swinging the bar. A staggered stance can help balance.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bent-over row
steps: Stand with feet comfortably apart, knees slightly bent.
Hinge forward at the hips with a neutral back. Let the weight hang below your shoulder.
Draw the elbow back, bringing the upper arm alongside your torso. Lower slowly.
exercises.cue: Brace your abdomen and keep the shoulder from rolling forward.
exercises.mistake: Rounding the spine or jerking the weight.

exercises.name: Dumbbell floor press
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with knees bent.
Position upper arms out from the torso and forearms upright.
Press the weights until the arms are almost straight, then lower with control.
exercises.cue: Keep the neck neutral and avoid locking the elbows.
exercises.mistake: Driving through the feet or dropping elbows below the torso on a bench.

exercises.name: Lying triceps extension
steps: Lie on your back. Point the upper arm toward the ceiling and bend the elbow.
Straighten the elbow to raise the weight.
Bend it again slowly while keeping the upper arm still.
exercises.cue: Use the other hand to support the upper arm if needed.
exercises.mistake: Moving the whole arm or shifting the head and trunk.

exercises.name: Knee push-up
steps: Start on hands and knees on a mat, hands slightly wider than shoulders.
Brace your abdomen and keep the back straight as you bend the elbows to lower your chest.
Press up slowly.
exercises.cue: Look toward the floor and keep the trunk aligned.
exercises.mistake: Sagging or arching the back, or rushing the repetition.

exercises.name: Stationary lunge
steps: Step one foot forward.
Bend both knees to a comfortable depth, keeping the front knee aligned with the foot.
Return to the starting stance with control. Repeat on the other side.
exercises.cue: Keep the back neutral and move only as far as you can control.
exercises.mistake: The front knee drifting inward or outward. Stop when form becomes difficult.

exercises.name: Dumbbell shoulder press
steps: Hold weights at shoulder height, elbows under wrists.
Brace your trunk and press overhead.
Return to shoulder height.
exercises.cue: Keep your chest lifted.
exercises.mistake: Losing trunk control during the press.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet grounded.
Brace your abdomen, then squeeze the glutes and lift the hips.
Lower with control.
exercises.cue: Aim for alignment through the trunk and thighs.
exercises.mistake: Overextending the lower back.

exercises.name: Step-up
steps: Place one foot on a sturdy low step.
Transfer weight onto that foot to stand on the step.
Step down carefully, then change sides.
exercises.cue: Use a stable surface.
exercises.mistake: Rushing the descent or using an unstable step.

exercises.name: Wall push-up
steps: Stand at arm’s length from a wall, hands at chest height.
Bend elbows beside your body and lean toward the wall.
Press back slowly.
exercises.cue: Keep your back straight.
exercises.mistake: Bending at the hips instead of keeping the body aligned.

exercises.name: Supported calf raise
steps: Hold a stable chair for balance.
Raise both heels as far as comfortable.
Lower slowly.
exercises.cue: Stay upright.
exercises.mistake: Moving quickly or losing balance.

exercises.name: Sit-to-stand
steps: Sit near the front of a stable chair, feet hip width apart.
Lean forward slightly and stand using your legs.
Sit down slowly.
exercises.cue: Look ahead; use your arms to guide your return.
exercises.mistake: Using a chair that rolls or slips.

exercises.name: Seated trunk rotation
steps: Sit upright, feet flat, arms crossed over your shoulders.
Turn your upper body gently without moving your hips.
Return to centre and change sides.
exercises.cue: Move within a comfortable range.
exercises.mistake: Forcing the rotation.

exercises.name: Seated ankle mobility
steps: Sit securely and hold the chair sides.
Straighten one leg and lift the foot.
Point the toes away, then draw them back. Change legs.
exercises.cue: Keep movement gentle.
exercises.mistake: Straining for extra range.

exercises.name: Seated chest stretch
steps: Sit upright with shoulders down and back.
Open the arms to the sides.
Gently lift the chest forward and upward.
exercises.cue: Hold a comfortable stretch briefly.
exercises.mistake: Forcing the shoulders backward.

exercises.name: Bird dog
steps: Start on all fours, hands below shoulders and knees below hips.
Brace your trunk. Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg backward.
Return with control and change sides.
exercises.cue: Keep the spine neutral and the hips level.
exercises.mistake: Rotating the pelvis, overreaching, or holding your breath.

exercises.name: Dead bug
steps: Lie on your back with arms up and hips and knees bent to right angles.
Keep your lower back against the floor as you extend opposite arm and leg toward the floor.
Return and alternate sides.
exercises.cue: Only extend as far as you can keep the trunk stable.
exercises.mistake: Arching the lower back or moving too quickly.

exercises.name: Forearm plank
steps: Lie face down with elbows below the shoulders and toes tucked.
Brace your trunk and lift your body, maintaining a straight line.
Breathe throughout the hold; lower with control.
exercises.cue: Keep shoulders away from the ears and the trunk aligned.
exercises.mistake: Sagging the hips or lifting them too high. Stop if you develop lower-back pain.

exercises.name: Walking
steps: Choose supportive, comfortable footwear and a suitable route.
Start at an easy pace and increase distance gradually.
For a brisk pace, aim to still be able to talk.
exercises.cue: Build up gradually if you are new to regular walking.
exercises.mistake: Increasing distance or pace faster than you can comfortably manage.
